Title: Public preview: Azure SQL updates for late-January 2024

Body.Content:
In late-January 2024, the following public preview enhancements were made to Azure SQL:

  • Azure SQL Managed Instance pools now have new functionalities. Save costs by migrating to 2-vCore instances within instance pools, while enjoying great flexibility including instance move into/out of the pool, pool resizing and hardware tier change.
